problem: A canoe traveled $280$ feet in $70$ seconds at a constant rate.  What is the speed of the canoe?
worked_solution:
Speed is a special unit rate applied to moving objects. It is defined as *the distance traveled per unit of time*:

$$
\text{speed}=\frac{\text{distance}}{\text{time}}
$$

To find the speed (in feet per second), we divide the number of feet, $280,$ by the number of seconds, $70.$ This gives,

$$
\frac{280}{70}=280÷70=4.
$$

Therefore, the speed of the canoe is $4$ feet per second.
